measurement_script:
import json,pathlib,subprocess,os,time,tempfile
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
prior=json.loads((repo/'eval/clones-capability/project-advisory-body-projection-study.json').read_text())
baseline=json.loads((pathlib.Path(prior['runs'][1]['root'])/'report.json').read_text())
cmd=prior['runs'][1]['command']
runs=[]
for i in range(3):
 root=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='clones-c94-profile-'))
 start=time.monotonic()
 with (root/'report.json').open('w') as out,(root/'perf.jsonl').open('w') as err:
  result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(root/'memory.txt')]+cmd,env=dict(os.environ,PATH='/home/dev/.cargo/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],RSTYLE_PERF='1'),stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=120)
 elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
 events=[]
 for line in (root/'perf.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
  try: events.append(json.loads(line.removeprefix('rstyle-perf ')))
  except json.JSONDecodeError: pass
 memory=(root/'memory.txt').read_text()
 equal=json.loads((root/'report.json').read_text())==baseline
 assert equal and result.returncode==1
 run=dict(command=cmd,root=str(root),elapsed=elapsed,exit=result.returncode,report_equal_to_c93=equal,events=events,memory_receipt=memory)
 runs.append(run)
 print(json.dumps(dict(index=i,elapsed=elapsed,report_equal_to_c93=equal,inventory_seconds=[e['elapsed_seconds'] for e in events if e['stage']=='cli.advisory.load_inventory' and e['event']=='finish'])) ,flush=True)
 pathlib.Path('/tmp/clones-c94-measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+'\n')
